title: Doushi Shoujo yo, Teki wo Ute
titleRomaji: Doushi Shoujo yo, Teki wo Ute
synopsis: In 1942, as the war on the Eastern Front intensified, the normal life of Serafima, a young girl living in a rural village near Moscow, is suddenly shattered. An assault by the German forces massacred the villagers, including her mother. Just as Serafima is about to be shot, she is rescued by Irina, a female soldier of the Red Army. Determined to defeat the enemies who killed her family, Serafima, along with her comrades, undergoes rigorous training to become snipers. (Source: HayaComic Web, translated)

titleRomaji: Dream Life: Yume no Isekai Seikatsu
titleNative: ドリーム・ライフ: 夢の異世界生活
synopsis: A middle-aged engineer who was weary of life ended up being reborn into a different world as Zack, the son of a frontier feudal lord. Once there, he received a mission from God. He was told to prepare himself for the task of “guiding the future hero of the world”. With that in mind, Zack not only trained himself in swordsmanship and magic but also committed himself towards reforming problems in hygiene and education. After developing a new local product, Zack was reminded of his once forgotten dream: brewing alcohol! As he resurrected his long lost passion, it was the beginning of his “Dream Life”.

When a sly professor discovers his racket, Jonathan agrees to a physical relationship in exchange for keeping mum. But what happens when a simple business transaction turns into a heated almost-love affair? Lies Are a Gentleman's Manners reveals the devilishly dirty secrets of the high-society set! With appearances to uphold and family legacies to honor, any "extracurricular" activity must be kept hush-hush. But can a man with a doting wife, a darling child, a spoiled lover and a sordid past truly get the balance right? (Source: Juné)
